text: The obstacle detector shall classify an obstacle as detected when distance <= 2 meters.
The obstacle processing task shall publish obstacle distance measurements.
The ambient-light task shall calculate filtered lux values.
The headlight controller shall enable the headlight output when filtered lux < 100.
The tire-pressure task shall calculate pressure deviation from the configured threshold.
The tire-pressure warning task shall set the warning flag when pressure is below threshold.
The parking detector shall classify proximity measurements up to 1.5 meters.
The parking warning task shall publish obstacle distance to the warning controller.
The hazard manager shall detect confirmed hazard events.
The warning output task shall generate an audible warning within 200 milliseconds.
The rain estimator shall calculate rainfall intensity from sensor readings.
The wiper controller shall enable wiping when rainfall exceeds the configured threshold.
The cruise controller shall calculate speed error using the configured target speed.
The cruise controller shall constrain speed error to the defined tolerance.
The battery monitor shall calculate voltage deviation across cells.
The battery diagnostic task shall report deviation when it exceeds 50 mV.
The door monitor shall detect door-state transitions.
The door event task shall publish an open-door event within 100 milliseconds.
The lane estimator shall calculate lateral distance to lane boundaries.
The lane warning task shall generate a warning when a boundary crossing is confirmed.
The obstacle processing task shall execute every 50 milliseconds.
The obstacle processing task shall ignore measurements marked invalid.
The ambient-light task shall execute at least every 100 milliseconds.
The tire-pressure acquisition task shall update status every 1 second.
The parking processing task shall execute every 50 milliseconds.
The hazard manager shall attach a timestamp to confirmed hazards.
The cruise speed task shall execute every 20 milliseconds.
The battery sampling task shall execute every 100 milliseconds.
The door sampling task shall execute every 20 milliseconds.
The lane estimation task shall execute every 50 milliseconds.
